title: G02/G06/G12: counter trust-boundary findings and scoped recovery evidence
public_pr_body:
Independent review of pinned #359 31f965e7. The unchanged 147 numbering guard accepted typed numbers from authenticated SQL callers who forged either internal custom GUC. Two conditional findings; browser/PostgREST reachability and full-schema constraints are not demonstrated. Expected refusal assertions remain failing; fixes pending owner review.

Actual day-of/undo scripts run only in new nonce-labelled, network-isolated PostgreSQL containers with identity checks before writes. Twelve fixture checks: ten passed, two bypass checks failed. All five fixture tables plus functions/indexes/constraints/sequences restored identically in latest 1.6836s; not a full Supabase/Auth/Storage/roles recovery or accepted RTO. Synthetic other-tenant counter unchanged is not a JNR wipe proof.

G02 strict recovery/identity assurance gaps recorded. Backup stub refusal suite passed after retaining its original socket failure. Full Supabase startup blocked by public.ecr.aws policy denial. G12 historical private wipe source reviewed without copying/executing private code; exact current combined-kit + isolated restored JNR/Marpet proof remains NOT EXECUTED.

Original setup/readiness/test failures, SQL statements/hashes/exits/times, identity receipts, logs and evidence hashes retained. Tested reviewer code commit 14c56ebb; later commit adds evidence only. Handover: tests/reviews/b5-g06/B5-G02-G06-G12-REVIEW.md.

- [x] Separate owned reviewer branch; original failures retained; source/lint/type/whitespace checks scoped in report. Raw logs kept byte-for-byte, including original whitespace.
- [ ] Independent owner assessment, actual final-candidate runtime evidence and authorised acceptance remain open.

Explicit Rhys overnight allocation. New b5 test/tool/review files only; no Claude-owned source/test edits, #359 branch modification, ISO pack work, Ready label, main merge, production migrations/wipe/import/counter change, deployment, live AI/automated email or message to John.
